items.criterion: A chapter poster is written to the object store when the author creates it.
items.judgment: Create a chapter and confirm the poster object exists in the store at its key.

items.criterion: A draft chapter poster is refused to a stranger.
items.judgment: Request a draft poster with no entitlement and confirm the refusal.

items.criterion: A published chapter poster is publicly readable.
items.judgment: Publish a chapter and confirm the poster is readable.

items.criterion: A reader prize-draw entry is stored.
items.judgment: Submit an entry and confirm the row exists.

items.criterion: At most one entry exists per reader.
items.judgment: Read the entries for a reader and confirm a single row.

items.criterion: Two concurrent entry submissions by one reader resolve to one winner.
items.judgment: Race two submissions and confirm one success and one conflict.

items.criterion: A replayed entry with the same client request id creates no second entry.
items.judgment: Replay a submission and confirm one row.

items.criterion: A reader publishing a chapter is refused.
items.judgment: Send a publish as a reader and confirm the refusal.

items.criterion: A chapter poster lives in the object store rather than on the app filesystem.
items.judgment: Confirm the poster object is present in the store.

items.criterion: An entry without the terms consent is refused as invalid.
items.judgment: Submit an entry with no terms consent and confirm the refusal.
